title: Интервью об образе жизни
description: Проиграй по ролям интервью об образе жизни: активный день, еда и выходные. Реплики появляются на экране по очереди.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Hi! Do you have an active lifestyle?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: Yes, I do. I go jogging in the park in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Do you go jogging every day?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: No, I don't. I jog three times a week and I play volleyball at the weekend.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Where do you usually do sport at the weekend?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: I usually play volleyball at the sports centre with my friends.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: That sounds great. Do you eat fast food?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: I sometimes do, but I don't eat it every day. I try to lead a healthy lifestyle.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Does your mum cook healthy meals?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: Yes, she does. She makes salads and soup, and we drink water, not fizzy drinks.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: What healthy meals does your mum cook?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: She often cooks vegetable soup and fresh salads for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Sounds delicious! Do you stay at home at the weekend?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: No, I don't. I don't like sitting at home all day.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Does your family go anywhere on Saturdays?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: Yes, we do. We often go to the countryside and enjoy peace and quiet.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: Where does your family go on Saturdays?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: We usually go to a small village near the river.

dialogue.speaker: interviewer
dialogue.text: That's nice. Thanks for telling me about your lifestyle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: You're welcome. See you later!
